summary: The opt-in Main ordinary-assignment path independently verifies complete authoritative obligations, snapshot and decision, then joins actual work/principal, requested configuration, input, derived generation, reservation and original fixed subscription budget. It stages full bounded evidence in the existing content-addressed store before immutable route and intent. Separate semantic-assignment and object-byte digests survive route/4, command/6, resolver readback, chunk transfer and retained runner launch equality. Fresh readiness must transfer the same evidence without invoking the provider. Canonical preparation retains ordinary envelopes and preserves historical plain and causal route encoding. Unsupported launch tools/checks/resources and missing or changed evidence refuse; optional experiment references need separate validation. Requested configuration and the actual single-repository baseline/input are joined, while retained resolved/observed values and provenance remain input evidence rather than authenticated provider observations. Deferred candidate/output and independent-review obligations are held before native merge/outcome acceptance under their existing acceptance owner. The source includes a real PostgreSQL-to-readiness-to-one-controlled-provider-invocation fixture plus mutation, interrupted-prefix, lost-output reconciliation and replacement controls. At capture, focused Host and Runner tests passed and the PostgreSQL fixture compiled; actual hosted PostgreSQL execution, exact-head CI and protected delivery remain separate gates. This source does not prove installed matched Host/Runner adoption, preventive filesystem isolation, runtime containment, complete framework/Python-JavaScript journeys, parent completion or economic effectiveness. The LEARN parent owns those continuations.
title: Ordinary assignment durable Main and runner source boundary
